summary: Tested new /experience route and portfolio regression. The /experience page renders correctly with all resume content and required testids. However, the homepage (/) is COMPLETELY BROKEN due to a runtime error in Nav.jsx — 'hashHref is not defined' — which crashes the <Nav> component and results in a blank white screen with no rendered content. Additionally, Nav.jsx does not match the review-request spec: it does not import react-router Link, does not mark Experience as internal, and does not include the new 'Work' nav link. Only /experience works because it uses its own topbar (not the shared Nav).

action_items: URGENT: Fix Nav.jsx — homepage is broken. (1) Add `import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';` (2) Define the missing `hashHref` helper (spec says it should resolve #-hrefs from non-root routes to `/#hash`), e.g. `const {pathname} = useLocation(); const hashHref = (h) => pathname === '/' ? h : '/' + h;`. (3) Update the `links` array to include the new 'Work' entry ({ label:'Work', href:'#work', testId:'nav-work-link' }) and mark Experience as { internal:true, to:'/experience', testId:'nav-experience-link' } so the final 6-link order becomes About / Experience / Work / Podcast / LinkedIn / Contact.
Once Nav is fixed, re-run regression tests on '/' to confirm hero, project cards (5 × 500×416), podcast, footer, nav-work-link scroll to #work, and nav-experience-link routes to /experience.

OPTIONAL: On /experience Education section, either update the MBA card to show 'SPJIMR' abbreviation as the review spec requests, or accept the fuller wording. Everything else on /experience is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx was pushed in an incomplete state — references undefined identifiers (hashHref, Link). Suggests the file was partially edited without saving all necessary changes. Add ESLint no-undef checks to CI to catch this class of bug.
Recommend adding a React error boundary around <Nav /> so a nav failure does not blank the entire app.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 fixes Nav.jsx (add Link import, define hashHref helper, add Work link and mark Experience as internal), re-run the portfolio regression: verify 6 nav links with correct testids, click nav-experience-link → /experience, click nav-work-link → scrolls to #work, hero View Resume href='/resume.pdf', 5 project cards visible, no console errors. The /experience page itself is already fully verified and passing.
rca of the issue: Root cause: Nav.jsx references `hashHref` (line 70) and `Link` (line 57) which are not defined nor imported. When React renders <Nav />, a ReferenceError is thrown and the entire React root unmounts (no error boundary), leaving <body> effectively empty. Reproduction: open https://pm-portfolio-57.preview.emergentagent.com/ — page is blank. Console shows 'PAGEERROR: hashHref is not defined' and 'An error occurred in the <Nav> component'. Mitigation: import Link from 'react-router-dom' and define hashHref helper as described in action_items; also add a Work link entry and mark Experience internal per the review spec.
